info.title: ArchiveX API
info.description:
REST API for ArchiveX — luxury discovery, archive, editorial, and collector platform.

**Base path:** `/api/v1`

**Auth:** Bearer access JWT (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Refresh tokens use httpOnly cookie `archivex_refresh` on `/api/v1/auth`.

**Public catalog** returns approved/active content only. Staff CMS lives under `/admin`.

**Roles:** `user` (collector) · staff `editor` | `moderator` | `admin` | `superadmin`.
Destructive admin deletes and user management require `admin` or `superadmin`. Status moderation requires `moderator+`.

name.description: Optional; derived from first/last when omitted

post.summary: Rotate access token via refresh cookie
Revoke refresh (if authenticated) and clear cookie
Submit a pending product under an active brand

patch.summary: Update my pending or rejected submission

delete.summary: Withdraw my pending or rejected submission

get.summary: Stream GridFS image bytes (not JSON envelope)
